subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight details are as follows: Flight: ABC123 Date: 15th August 2022 Departure: 10:00 AM Arrival: 2:00 PM Seat: 12A Please make sure to arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. For any changes or inquiries, feel free to contact our customer support team. We wish you a pleasant journey! Best regards, Airline Team
